findings.description: Removing the already_bracketed guard means an optional parameter whose metavar already starts and ends with brackets is now wrapped again, producing doubled brackets like [[FOO]] in usage text.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an optional option with a custom metavar such as "[FOO]" (not required). Previously already_bracketed was True so var stayed "[FOO]". Now the condition is only `not self.required`, so var becomes "[[FOO]]". Impact: the help/usage output shows doubled brackets, a visible regression for users who supplied bracketed metavars.
